methodology.definition: 跨会议提炼甲方反复践行的逻辑、原则、管理理论及其对数据和功能的要求

task_contract.missing_value_policy: infer a concrete proposal when reasonable and mark it for human confirmation

responsibility.primary_owner_rule: the overall team lead responsible for the matter is primary owner
responsibility.participant_rule: all listed business sections share responsibility

evidence.missing_raw_policy: surface an evidence gap and keep the conclusion candidate

conflicts.policy: keep related items side by side and request human judgment

valid: actionable conclusion awaiting human confirmation or dispatch
concrete gap converted into a human-resolvable next step
